test.title: Bike hire scheme — how it works

paragraphs.text: Bikes can be picked up at 24 docking stations across the city. The first 30 minutes cost nothing; after that the charge is £1.50 for each additional half hour. A day pass costs £5.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Bikes must be returned to a docking station, not left in the street. If a station is full, the app will add ten minutes of free time so that riders can reach the next one, which is never more than 600 metres away.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: How many docking stations are there?
How long is the free period at the start?
How much extra time does the app give if a station is full?
What is the greatest distance to the next station?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
